originalTitle: Airbnb is working on an AI travel agent

content: Airbnb plans to roll out an AI agent in the first half of 2027 that will help users plan and book travel, the company said in its Q3 2026 earnings shareholder letter released today. “Today’s AI agents are good at simple, routine tasks, like making a restaurant reservation or scheduling an appointment,” Airbnb said. “But planning a trip on Airbnb is different.” The company argued that its experience matching hosts and guests, its current role in being part of reservations already, and a “new interface” built “specifically for travel” gives it an edge. Here’s how Airbnb says that new interface will work: > We don’t think a traditional chatbot is the right way to plan a trip. We’re developing a custom-designed, AI-native experience that builds the interface around your question. Rather than a chat window, our agent draws on a library of hundreds of travel-specific interface elements—maps, photos, comparisons, calendars, itineraries—and composes them in real time to match what you’re looking for. Our agent will help guests explore options, make decisions with the people they’re traveling with, and take action directly in Airbnb. Airbnb co-founder and CEO Brian Chesky has said before that the company plans to launch an agent in 2027, telling the Skift Global Forum that it would have an interface that’s “much richer than a chatbot.” In its shareholder letter, Airbnb also said that AI is “the best thing to ever happen to Airbnb” and has changed how it develops products and operates.

chineseContent: Airbnb 在今天发布的 2026 年第三季度盈利股东信中表示，该公司计划在 2027 年上半年推出人工智能代理，帮助用户计划和预订旅行。 Airbnb 表示：“如今的人工智能代理擅长执行简单的日常任务，例如预订餐厅或安排预约。” “但在 Airbnb 上计划旅行是不同的。”该公司辩称，其经验匹配主人和客人，目前已经成为预订的一部分，以及“专门为旅行”构建的“新界面”给了它优势。 Airbnb 表示新界面的运作方式如下： > 我们认为传统的聊天机器人不是计划旅行的正确方式。我们正在开发一种定制设计的人工智能原生体验，围绕您的问题构建界面。我们的代理不是使用聊天窗口，而是利用包含数百个旅行特定界面元素（地图、照片、比较、日历、行程）的库，并实时组合它们以匹配您正在寻找的内容。我们的代理将帮助房客探索选择、与同行者一起做出决定，并直接在爱彼迎中采取行动。 Airbnb 联合创始人兼首席执行官布莱恩·切斯基 (Brian Chesky) 此前曾表示，该公司计划在 2027 年推出代理，并告诉 Skift 全球论坛，它将拥有一个“比聊天机器人丰富得多”的界面。 Airbnb 在股东信中还表示，人工智能是“Airbnb 有史以来发生的最好的事情”，并改变了其开发产品和运营的方式。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
